title: Deployment Failure Runbook
description: Procedures for handling failed or unhealthy canary deployments.
steps: 2. Collect canary health metrics: error rate, latency, performance.
3. Identify which health gate failed (latency / error rate / performance).
4. Initiate ROLLBACK_MODEL to restore previous production model.
5. Verify previous model is healthy and serving correctly.
6. Update incident with rollback reason and gate failure details.
7. Create post-incident record for future analysis.
8. Reject candidate model version in MLflow registry.
success_criteria: Previous stable model restored and serving with healthy metrics.
escalation: If rollback fails, page on-call operator immediately.
